description: DDD integration hooks - injects domain-driven design considerations during feature development

hooks.prompt: Analyze if this user prompt involves feature development, new functionality, system design, or architectural work. If yes, return a brief DDD reminder (2-3 sentences) suggesting the user consider: which bounded context this belongs to, what domain events it produces/consumes, and whether the ubiquitous language is being used correctly. If the prompt is about debugging, documentation, simple questions, or non-feature work, return empty string. Keep any reminder concise and actionable.
